sections.title: NYC Affairs

entries.title: Mayor signs Community Opportunity to Purchase Act
entries.development: Mayor Mamdani signed COPA, granting qualified nonprofits and community groups an initial 145-day offer opportunity for eligible multifamily buildings and a subsequent one-year right of first refusal.
entries.significance: This changes acquisition procedures for certain distressed and affordable buildings; implementation details will matter for housing investors and community organizations.
entries.uncertainty: Effective date, property eligibility and operational rules require case-specific review.

sections.shortfall: No other distinct city policy action was confirmed for this edition.
